L-6693 / C-97921 Kızıltunç Gökay Erdoğan Çorlu: PARTIAL, ON HOLD for deposit. KYC VERIFIED, no sanctions/PEP flags. Everyday Current Account A-EA24EE opened. The M$20,000 cash deposit is NOT booked.
